label: EXPLORATORY_PILOT
horizon: next-24h realized variance from 1h mark-price close-to-close log returns t+1..t+24

bootstrap.unit: UTC day block, resampled jointly across instruments, per split and pooled

sign_convention: mean_delta_qlike_vs_A = mean(QLIKE_A - QLIKE_model); QLIKE is a loss, lower is better; positive = model BETTER than RV-only

placebo.description: Funding rate values deterministically permuted across their observation timestamps (seed 12345 + symbol offset); identical feature/estimation/evaluation pipeline; E_rv_funding_trails compared to real A.

materiality.floor: E beats A (mean(QLIKE_A - QLIKE_E) > 0 with bootstrap CI95 lower bound > 0) in >=3 of 4 holdouts AND real funding-trail |mean delta QLIKE| exceeds placebo |mean delta QLIKE|

honest_status: EXPLORATORY/PILOT. Multi-holdout robustness plus a funding-permutation placebo. See materiality.materiality_floor_met for the pre-registered verdict; a negative result is a valid completion and no confirmatory promotion is claimed.
